results.title: Passenger file: data dictionary
results.raw_content: Pclass: the passenger class of the ticket, where 1 = first, 2 = second and 3 = third [...] SibSp: the number of siblings or spouses the passenger had aboard [...] Name: the passenger's full name, as written on the ticket and listed in the passenger register of the voyage, surname first

results.title: Parch explained
results.content: Parch is the number of parents or children aboard with the passenger.
